Solara — (9.4) QUASAR

CLOUDY WITH A CHANCE OF FLARE

"Cloudy with a chance of flare"

[Verse 1]

Something shifted

At Level Three of Fold Two

Not an earthquake

Folds do not have earthquakes

More like the fold itself

Took a breath it was not planning to take

Lara stopped writing mid-sentence

She said: did you feel that

Everyone felt that

Nobody said yes

Because saying yes meant it was real

[Pre-Chorus]

Castor looked northwest

The direction did not make sense in a fold

Direction works differently here

But northwest was where he looked

And there was light

[Chorus]

Cloudy with a chance of flare

Something in the northwest burning

Cloudy with a chance of flare

The signal went quiet between us

We cannot reach her

She cannot reach us

The fold is doing something

We do not understand

Hold the level

Hold the level

She will find us or we will find her

Hold the level

[Verse 2]

Persy said: I know what to do

Rion said: yes so do I

They looked at each other

They did not know what to do

Lara said: the fold is bending

She said: I can feel it

She said: I have notes on this

She said: not many notes

She said: more like half a note

She said: the half that says this is bad

Castor said: can you follow the light

Lara said: I do not know

She said: I have never followed a light in a fold before

She said: not at this level

She said: not with this kind of flare

[Pre-Chorus 2]

Cygnus danced one very small step northwest

Nobody told him to

He just did

Herc said: I will lift something if it helps

Rion said: there is nothing to lift

Herc said: I know

He lifted nothing

He felt better

[Bridge]

And then the signal came back

Very faint

Very far

Like something being said across a very long hallway

By someone whose person was in two places at once

They could not hear words

Just the shape of her

The outline

She was still there

She was in two places at once

And only one of them was her

Castor said: northwest

He said: that light

He said: that is the way

Lara looked at her half-note

She wrote the rest of it

She wrote: northwest is the way

[Final Chorus]

Cloudy with a chance of flare

We found the direction

Cloudy with a chance of flare

We do not know what we will find

She is there and not there

Split and still standing

And we are going northwest

To get her back

Hold the level

Hold the level

We are going northwest

We are going now

[Outro]

Persy said: let’s go

He said it like he had known all along

He had not known all along

Rion was already walking

He said: I still think I know what to do

Lara said: you just said you didn’t

Rion said: I said that before

He said: I know now

Lara looked at him

She wrote: unclear
